AOPackage.description: Everything provisioned for an Area of Operations, packaged ready to plan against (DEC-11/12/52). Not yet assembled as one object in the v1 skeleton.
AOPackage.title: AOPackage

Activity.description: The verb of a commitment — visit, loiter, avoid, transit, maintain (DEC-16/21). `where` is a Waypoint or a boolean predicate over map cells (DEC-33); `when` is a window, before/after, or recurring. Always inlined in its Commitment (no independent identity).

effects.description: "v1: self-state delta / persistent marker (always empty in the skeleton)"

relevant_channels.description: channel ids to sample / trigger on (DEC-21)

where.description: the location — a map cell (skeleton uses {x, y, alias})

where_predicate.description: alternative to `where` — a boolean predicate tree over cells (DEC-33)

Activity.title: Activity

after.description: sequencing — id of a commitment this must follow (e.g. "cmt-1")

ActivityType.description: The verb of an activity (DEC-16); v1 set, pluggable registry (NF7).
ActivityType.title: ActivityType

Alert.description: A band crossing or hard-infeasibility raised during execution (E3).
Alert.title: Alert

AlertCauseType.description: Why the wingman raised an execution alert (E3).
AlertCauseType.title: AlertCauseType

Appetite.description: One risk-appetite dial setting (DEC-6) — e.g. tempo = rapid, exposure = cautious.
Appetite.title: Appetite

Aspect.description: One facet of an entity, over time (DEC-52/53) — its position, an altitude, a timing window, an up/down status — rendered onto a shared axis by a view. Its value `f(t)` is behaviour, evaluated across the seam, and is not a data slot; the render-type, unit and bounds *are* data.
Aspect.title: Aspect

AspectType.description: The render-class of one time-varying facet of an entity (DEC-52/53).
AspectType.title: AspectType

Attribution.description: Who decided, under what authority, when. Stamped on every committing act — this is universal rule 2 (DEC-15, NF2).

authority.description: the authority the act was taken under

Attribution.title: Attribution

Band.description: A coarse three-level qualitative band for cost / robustness (C2/C6, NF10).
Band.title: Band

Baseline.description: The world as known truth (DEC-7/20/28): a medium (land/sea/air grid) carrying channels and per-cell attributes, plus a single fact layer that observations append to. Immutable and versioned; the kernel always evaluates baseline ⊕ excursion ⊕ plan-effects-to-date (DEC-19).

facts.description: the one truth; observations append here

forecast_changepoints.description: when the world is expected to shift

id.description: content id of the canonical form (DEC-35)

Baseline.title: Baseline

Capture.description: The negotiation record behind a commitment — answers, the canonical contract text, open ambiguities (DEC-17).

echo_back.description: the canonical contract text read back to the operator

Capture.title: Capture

Cell.description: One grid cell's attributes (skeleton mobility raster).
Cell.title: Cell

CellPredicate.description: A boolean tree over map cells (DEC-33): an atom, or and/or/not of sub-predicates. Atoms are a pluggable registry (land-cover, elevation, slope, static-LOS, near(feature, dist)). Conceptual — the skeleton uses Waypoints only.

atom.description: the atom name when op = atom (e.g. land-cover, slope)

CellPredicate.title: CellPredicate

Changepoint.description: A forecast time at which a channel is expected to shift (e.g. a tidal ford opening) (DEC-21).
Changepoint.title: Changepoint

Channel.description: A field over space and time — tide, cloud, risk, mobility (DEC-19/21). Its values are conceptually `f(cell, t)`, however realised; that function is resolved across the seam (DEC-49) and is *not* a data slot here. For parametric/periodic channels the realising parameters (`params`) *are* data and are modelled.
Channel.title: Channel

ChannelDelta.description: How the world is edited (DEC-34): a parametric delta (time-shift, scale, mask) from a pluggable registry, or a raw cell patch (the escape hatch). Not yet implemented in the v1 skeleton.

patches.description: raw (cell, t, value) patches — when kind = cell_patch

type.description: the parametric delta type (registry) — when kind = parametric

ChannelDelta.title: ChannelDelta

ChannelParams.description: Parameters of a parametric/periodic channel — e.g. the skeleton's tidal ford (ADR-0006).

applies_to.description: the cell/feature the params apply to (e.g. the ford alias)

low_tide_min.description: first low tide, in mission minutes

open_half_width_min.description: ±minutes around low tide the ford is wadeable

ChannelParams.title: ChannelParams

Commitment.description: One thing the plan must achieve (DEC-16/17/22). Either hard (must hold) or soft with a priority. Carries the negotiated contract text and any unresolved ambiguities, and walks a lifecycle of states.
Commitment.title: Commitment

CommitmentProvenance.description: A commitment's ownership and waiver authority (B3).
CommitmentProvenance.title: CommitmentProvenance

CommitmentState.description: The lifecycle state of a commitment (B4). `at-risk` is live-only (E2) and not stored.
CommitmentState.title: CommitmentState

Conflict.description: A first-class, named clash when commitments cannot all be kept (C1) — not a silent failure.

narrative.description: what the clash is, in words

Conflict.title: Conflict

ConflictKind.description: Whether a clash is built into the request or emerges from the schedule (C1).
ConflictKind.title: ConflictKind

Constraint.description: One interpreted operator steering gesture (DEC-24) — e.g. a no-go region.
Constraint.title: Constraint

Criticality.description: Whether a commitment must hold or is best-effort (DEC-22).
Criticality.title: Criticality

DataProvenance.description: The source and trust of a datum or entity (DEC-19). Trivial defaults in v1.

kind.description: source-class — one of: self, planned, forecast, observed, provider. The prose model separates entity kind (self/actor/feature/phenomenon) from data provenance (planned/forecast/observed); the skeleton folds them, using self/forecast/provider. A documented string rather than an enum (see the AspectType note).

DataProvenance.title: DataProvenance

Domain.description: The medium a baseline / profile / movement model operates in (DEC-20).
Domain.title: Domain

Effect.description: A delta a plan's activity applies from a point in time (DEC-19/34) — a ChannelDelta or a self-state delta. Referenced from Activity.effects; always empty in the v1 skeleton.

source_activity.description: the activity that applies the effect

Effect.title: Effect

hours.description: how long it can keep going

Entity.description: Anything located with an identity — yourself, an actor, a feature, a phenomenon (DEC-52). Where a Channel is a field, an Entity is a thing, projected across synchronised views. To affect the plan it is *cast* to a Channel or Commitment (actor → moving risk channel; window → timing commitment); in v1 entities are display-only. Skeleton note: aspects are keyed by name in an object (phase/fuel/height/pass); modelled here as a list of named Aspects.

kind.description: conceptual kind (DEC-52) — one of: self, actor, feature, phenomenon. Optional; the skeleton folds this into provenance.kind. A documented string rather than an enum (see the AspectType note).

Entity.title: Entity

Excursion.description: A named, versioned set of deltas layered on a baseline — "what if the weather turns?" — without disturbing the underlying truth (DEC-7). Not yet implemented in the v1 skeleton.

base.description: the baseline version it sits on

Excursion.title: Excursion

ExecutionLog.description: The append-only live history of a mission (DEC-23/25/26): alerts when a band is crossed, observations that update truth, waivers, and replans — never overwritten. Together with rationales and stamps it gives a complete after-action record with perfect replay (F1).
ExecutionLog.title: ExecutionLog

FactLayer.description: The single truth layer; observations append here (E5). Collapses excursions and forecast entities over time.
FactLayer.title: FactLayer

Lineage.description: Hash-link back to the version this one supersedes (universal rule 1).

amending_order_ref.description: reference to the amending order, if any

previous_version.description: id of the prior Requirement version

Lineage.title: Lineage

LogEntry.description: Base of the append-only execution log; the store stamps each with a `seq`.
LogEntry.title: LogEntry

MarginBand.description: The slack band on a single commitment's satisfaction (A2, NF10). `crossed` = violated.
MarginBand.title: MarginBand

Materialisation.description: The cached, regenerable working-out of a plan; absent when the plan is infeasible.

kernel_version_verified.description: the kernel version that verified the materialisation

tide.description: the tide decision at plan time

Materialisation.title: Materialisation

Medium.description: The domain, grid and cell-attribute schema of a baseline (DEC-20/28).

cell_attrs.description: the names of the per-cell attributes carried (e.g. mobility, cover)

Medium.title: Medium

MovementModel.description: Per-domain cost of travel, and anisotropic — a property of the edge between cells, not the cell (DEC-49/34): slope-along-direction on land, current/wind vectors at sea and in air. Its cost function `cost_speed = f(cell→cell, t, profile)` is behaviour, resolved across the seam — only `domain` and `realisation` are data here. Not yet implemented in the v1 skeleton.
MovementModel.title: MovementModel

Observation.description: A fact delta appended to the baseline's fact layer (E5).
Observation.title: Observation

Plan.description: A candidate solution whose id IS the hash of its Stamp (DEC-5/22/29). Its materialisation (schedule, trajectory, state curves) is cached and regenerable; its scores and first-class conflicts make it comparable. The skeleton also carries the chosen `strategy` and the `tide_decision` weighing.

tide_decision.description: the exfil wait-vs-detour weighing (ADR-0006); null when no ford

Plan.title: Plan

Predictability.description: How predictable a channel is over time (DEC-21) — drives sampling.
Predictability.title: Predictability

Profile.description: What a platform can do — the fixed capabilities a sensitivity sweep varies (DEC-19/20, F5). Immutable and versioned, content-addressed.

id.description: content id of the canonical form (DEC-35)

Profile.title: Profile

Realisation.description: How a channel or movement model is realised (DEC-49). `provider` = a computed service behind the seam.
Realisation.title: Realisation

Replan.description: A move from one committed plan to another, with rationale (DEC-36). Not yet logged in the v1 skeleton.
Replan.title: Replan

Requirement.description: The command's narrative intent, owned as a versioned immutable object (DEC-5/18). Amend it and you get a new version with lineage — the original stands. Content-addressed: its id is the hash of its canonical form.

id.description: content id (sha256:…) of the canonical form (DEC-35)

intent.description: the command's narrative, in their words

Requirement.title: Requirement

Satisfaction.description: One commitment's verdict and slack within a plan.

margin_min.description: slack in minutes; may be negative

Satisfaction.title: Satisfaction

ScheduleLeg.description: One leg of a plan's schedule. Exfil legs may carry a tide hold (ADR-0006).

commitment_id.description: the commitment this leg serves (visit/exfil legs)

ScheduleLeg.title: ScheduleLeg

ScheduleLegKind.description: The kind of one leg in a plan's schedule.
ScheduleLegKind.title: ScheduleLegKind

Scores.description: A plan's comparable scores, read under the comparability guard (A2/C2/C6, NF10).
Scores.title: Scores

SelectionRationale.description: The record of a choice (DEC-23): which plan won, which it beat, on which axis, with the after-mitigation bands, and who decided. Content-addressed.

appetites.description: the risk-appetite selections at the time

deciding_axis.description: "what tipped it — e.g. time/speed, exposure, robustness, completeness"

id.description: content id of the canonical form (DEC-35)

SelectionRationale.title: SelectionRationale

Stamp.description: Every input that determines a plan, bundled into one identity (DEC-23/24/29): which requirement, which world, which config core, what appetites and steering, which kernel and seed. A plan's id IS the hash of its Stamp, so two plans are comparable only when their stamps share a basis (the comparability guard). Skeleton additions (DEC-47): `profile_version` and `start` are part of identity because the plan depends on the platform and the starting state.

config_core_hash.description: hash of the world-defining config core — medium/channels/movement-model/providers/vocabulary; the instance shell is excluded (DEC-48)

excursions.description: ids of the excursion versions (empty in v1)

profile_version.description: id of the profile version (skeleton addition, DEC-47)

strategy_seed.description: RNG seed for strategy ordering — part of identity (DEC-29)

Stamp.title: Stamp

StartState.description: The starting position and clock baked into a Stamp (skeleton, DEC-47).
StartState.title: StartState

State.description: The platform right now — the live condition the kernel re-anchors to during execution (DEC-19). It is the privileged self-entity (DEC-52): its fields are the dynamic aspects of the `self` Entity (position → map/distance; endurance/availability → state curves).

clock_min.description: the current mission time, in minutes

State.title: State

StateCurves.description: The end-state of the platform's curves over the plan (v1 carries fuel only).
StateCurves.title: StateCurves

Strategy.description: One candidate strategy in the plan handful (skeleton).
Strategy.title: Strategy

StrategyKey.description: The skeleton's three candidate strategies (the "handful" of plans).
StrategyKey.title: StrategyKey

Terrain.description: Per-cell land-cover class used by the skeleton's mobility raster.
Terrain.title: Terrain

TideDecision.description: The result of the tidal-ford wait-vs-detour weighing (ADR-0006): the kernel materialises the exfil both ways — wait at the bank vs a ford-free detour — and commits to the earlier RV arrival, publishing the choice here.

detour_rv.description: mission minutes the detour route reaches the RV; null when no detour exists

ford_rv.description: mission minutes the ford route reaches the RV

wait_min.description: minutes held at the bank before crossing

TideDecision.title: TideDecision

TideMode.description: The outcome of the tidal-ford wait-vs-detour weighing (ADR-0006).
TideMode.title: TideMode

TimingConstraint.description: When an activity must happen — exactly one form is used (DEC-16).
TimingConstraint.title: TimingConstraint

TrajectoryPoint.description: One sampled point on the platform's path; coordinates may be fractional, time/fuel rounded to 1 dp for IEEE stability.
TrajectoryPoint.title: TrajectoryPoint

Verdict.description: A commitment's verdict in a plan's scores.
Verdict.title: Verdict

Waiver.description: A relaxed commitment, attributed (B3). Not yet logged in the v1 skeleton.
Waiver.title: Waiver
